An '''unidentified Gamorrean''' worked as a guard for the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Jib Kopatha]] on [[Void Station]] during the early parts of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a few months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] visited Void Station, in order to extract information from Kopatha about the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] whereabouts. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] claimed that gaining such information were very hard to find, which caused Vader to put pressure on him by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|choke]] him.

Kopatha's [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] tried to intervene, charging towards Vader. The [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]], wielding an [[Arg'garok/Legends|arg'garok]], was soon [[Death/Legends|killed]], when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] used his [[Unidentified Nikto protector|fallen comrade's]] [[Sword/Legends|sword]] to impale him with [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].
